harness_entries.normalization: lean_dfg_of_log_edges transcribes dfgOfLog's literal unaggregated edge list (one (from,to,1) triple per adjacent pair per trace, matching the Lean term exactly); lean_dfg_of_log_weight then aggregates via a filter+sum mirroring Dfg.weight's existing filter/foldr definition (unchanged by this checkpoint) -- the same state-then-aggregate discipline checkpoint 017 established for dfgOfTrace, now applied one level up at the log carrier.
harness_entries.method_note: 10 tests: empty log, single-trace (matches dfgOfTrace_singleton), repeated-pair-within-one-trace, the central multi-trace claim (weight sums across traces rather than concatenating or counting trace-membership), a general per-trace-sum property check over 5 traces including an empty one, empty-traces-contribute-nothing, start/end-activity tallying across traces, empty-traces excluded from start/end tallies, a negative falsifier (trace-count aggregation vs. real occurrence-sum aggregation), and the lean-file-hash citation-freshness test. Not exhaustive -- logs are unbounded collections of unbounded traces, same rigor tier as checkpoints 012/016/017.
